description: Return the exact Motzkin number M_n for a bounded sequence index.

source.title: Motzkin Numbers
source.publisher: Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series A

output.encoding: M_n, where M_0=M_1=1 and M_n=M_(n-1)+sum(M_i*M_(n-2-i), i=0..n-2)

contract.definition: M_n counts Motzkin excursions of length n: paths from height zero to height zero using up, level, and down steps and never going below zero.
contract.primary_method: Bottom-up convolution recurrence M_0=M_1=1; M_n=M_(n-1)+sum(M_i*M_(n-2-i), i=0..n-2).
contract.independent_method: Binomial-Catalan sum M_n=sum(binomial(n,2k)*Catalan(k), k=0..floor(n/2)); binomial values use multiplicative exact division and Catalan(k)=binomial(2k,k)/(k+1).
contract.invalid_cases: Null input, empty frame, trailing word, negative n, or n>30 returns -1.
contract.overflow_proof: All primary convolution terms are nonnegative and their sum is at most M_30=1,697,385,471,211. In the independent sum, each term is bounded by binomial(30,15)*Catalan(15)<1.51e15; at most 16 terms total less than 2.5e16, below signed-i64 maximum.

complexity.primary_time: O(n^2), at most 435 convolution products for n<=30
complexity.independent_time: O(n^2) operations from O(n) summands with multiplicative coefficient calculations
